description: This file defines a React component named ControlDevicesTab for managing control device mappings associated with an asset. It includes state management, API interactions for CRUD operations, and UI elements such as data tables, modals, and forms.

methods.name: buildDeviceIndex
methods.description: Builds a map from control device IDs to their corresponding master data objects.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Reloads the list of control device mappings.

methods.name: openCreate
methods.description: Initializes the form for creating a new control device mapping and opens the modal.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Prepares and opens the modal for editing an existing control device mapping.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles saving of the new or edited control device mapping, including validation, API calls, and UI updates.
